summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2L.4 independently verifies (VERIFICATION ONLY -- no real hardware, no hac-dell, no real protected-state write, no HMIC/contract change, no Principal/Signer/DeploymentBinding creation, no HATP activation) the repair implemented by 149O.20L.7O.2L.3 of the sole Blocking finding independently identified by 149O.20L.7O.2L.2 (HARDWARE-ENROLLMENT RECOVERY AUTHORITY DEFECT). True phase-entry commit: f72113a0. Used isolated git worktree checkpoints (not stash-only) at the vulnerable checkpoint 2396055f (post-2L.1/pre-2L.3, confirmed by git diff against 2L.3's own repair commit b010cdff) and the repaired checkpoint (current HEAD, identical source to b010cdff for all files this verification concerns), then removed both worktrees after use. Independently re-read HHCE-001 v1.1 full text, the 149O.20L.7O.2L architecture-freeze document, the current scripts/hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py (310 lines), src/pcae/core/hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py (649 lines), src/pcae/core/hatp_fido2_provider.py, and src/pcae/core/hatp_hardware_credentials.py directly -- not trusted from 2L.3's own interpretation. Confirmed HHCE-REQ-015 names exactly register_credential/revoke_credential with no third operation; confirmed the real security boundary is OS write permission plus the standalone script's own CLI surface, never an in-process provenance check inside the core writer. Reconstructed the current public CLI directly via argparse inspection: exactly {enroll, revoke}, no hidden alias, no --credential-id/--public-key/--provider-profile/--protocol-name/--algorithm flag anywhere, --signer-key-id present only under revoke as an existing-record lookup key. Independently reproduced the historical fabricated-evidence exploit against the frozen vulnerable source blob (git show 2396055f:scripts/hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py): _cmd_recover constructs CredentialEnrollmentEvidence directly from args.* fields with zero call to enroll_credential/_run_enrollment_ceremony, then calls register_credential directly -- executed concretely against a disposable tmp_path store root, confirming the vulnerable checkpoint persists a fully fabricated active HardwareCredentialRecord with zero hardware ceremony (historical Blocking finding independently reconfirmed to have really existed). Applied the conceptually identical attack to the repaired CLI (central closure test): register_credential monkeypatched to raise AssertionError if reached; recover invocation returns nonzero exit code at argparse parsing; the monkeypatch never fired; zero record created. Instrumented enroll identity provenance (CredentialEnrollmentEvidence's four identity fields trace exclusively to Fido2HardwareProvider.enroll_credential()'s own output object, no caller override); exactly-one-hardware-ceremony (a flaky register_credential requiring 3 calls still produces exactly 1 _run_enrollment_ceremony call); retry object identity (all 3 attempts pass the identical Python object, is-compared, not just field-equal); retry authority boundary (the retry helper is called from exactly one place in the module, textually after the ceremony call; no argparse dest maps onto a CredentialEnrollmentEvidence field beyond enrollment_reference). Independently classified _register_with_in_process_retry's exact catch scope (_HANDLED_ERRORS = HATPHardwareCredentialAdminError, HATPHardwareCredentialStoreError, HATPHardwareProviderError, OSError, tuple-equality-asserted against the live module) across nine injected failure categories: transient/uncertain failure (retried, correct), already-landed idempotent replay (real core register_credential, resolves ALREADY_REGISTERED, no duplicate), deterministic conflict (retried full 3-attempt budget then fails closed -- classified Non-Blocking, redundant but harmless since the conflict path never writes), malformed on-disk state (retried 3 times, never heals, fails closed -- Non-Blocking), permission/path failure (retried 3 times, no fallback/chmod/chown in source, fails closed -- Non-Blocking), unexpected programming exception (AttributeError/TypeError, NOT caught, propagates on first attempt -- classified CLEAN, appropriately narrow), never-landed write (fails once then lands, one final record), exhausted retries (finite 3 attempts, no infinite loop, last error re-raised, no false success), no-recovery-evidence output (captured stderr contains no 'RECOVERY EVIDENCE' text and no --public-key-hex/--signer-key-id flag values, only signer_key_id -- a public non-secret identifier -- and 'governed reconciliation' language). Confirmed confirmation zero-touch for both enroll (writer calls=0 on decline) and revoke (writer calls=0 on decline); revoke regression (valid revoke, idempotent monotonic replay, missing-ID fails closed, no other record mutated); Principal/Signer script git-diff-asserted byte-identical since 2L.3's own phase entry AND since the vulnerable checkpoint; all six core writer/provider modules byte-identical since the vulnerable checkpoint; both contract files (HHCE-001, HPSE-001) byte-identical since the vulnerable checkpoint, HHCE-001 remains v1.1; thin-wrapper AST call-set for the retry helper is exactly {register_credential, print, range, len, type}; no json/fcntl primitive anywhere in the script; fresh independent HMIC-REQ-052 application derives YES for both scripts (independently reasoned from each script's own control flow, not quoted from 2L.3); _FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES independently confirmed exactly 36 live-object-asserted, neither script a current member, future delta independently re-derived as exactly 36 -> 38 (set-union-computed, not trusted). Reasoned about the Dell certification boundary without connecting to Dell: hac-dell's active certification remains about its own deployed source generation, unaffected by and not validating this Mac-side-only development. All six required original-finding-closure elements independently established (recover absent; no equivalent import path; fabricated evidence cannot reach registration via public CLI -- the central closure test; identity derives only from provider output; retry is not an externally-supplied-identity channel; no new provenance bypass) -- the original HARDWARE-ENROLLMENT RECOVERY AUTHORITY DEFECT finding is independently CLOSED, not merely narrated as closed. Separately adjudicated a new retry-quality finding, NB-2L.4-1 (Non-Blocking): the catch scope retries several deterministic/non-transient failure classes that cannot be healed by identical-evidence replay -- wasteful but every affected path still fails closed with an unmodified final outcome, no authority or safety effect; explicitly not conflated with the original defect's closure. Wrote a freshly-authored 45-test independent suite (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_2l_4_hatp_hardware_credential_admin_recovery_authority_repair_independent_verification.py) that does not import or reuse any 2L.3 test module -- 45/45 pass. Combined focused run across test_hatp_hardware_credential_admin_script.py + test_hatp_principal_signer_admin_script.py + all five 2L/2L.1/2L.2/2L.3/2L.4 phase test files: 179/179 pass. Ran a full git-worktree-isolated A/B fast_green comparison (not stash-only) between the vulnerable checkpoint (2396055f) and the current repaired tree under python -m pytest -m fast_green -n auto -q: vulnerable 334 failed/8471 passed/4 skipped/9 errors (203.36s), repaired 333 failed/8498 passed/4 skipped/9 errors (191.24s). Exact FAILED/ERROR node-ID diff found exactly one candidate-only node (tests/test_shell_gate.py::TestAuditPersistence::test_audit_verify_cli) and two vulnerable-only nodes (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7n_1_dell_redeployment_proposition_independent_verification.py::TestCandidateCurrentness::test_head_equals_origin_main, tests/test_shell_gate.py::TestAuditPersistence::test_verify_detects_tampered_record). Investigated each individually: test_head_equals_origin_main necessarily fails in any detached-HEAD worktree checkout comparing against origin/main -- a checkpoint-comparison artifact, not a code regression; both TestAuditPersistence nodes were re-run in isolation (no -n auto) and all 7 tests in that class passed, confirming pytest-xdist-parallel flakiness unrelated to any file this phase or 2L.3 touched. Zero attributable regressions. Raw Fast Green numbers reported honestly above, not converted to '0 failed' shorthand; attributable regressions are separately and explicitly 0 failed. Zero FIDO2/PIV physical-device interaction occurred in any test this phase wrote (every provider/ceremony interaction is a synthetic monkeypatched or fake object); hac-dell remained untouched throughout; no real protected writer path was exercised (every register_credential/revoke_credential call in this phase's tests targets a disposable tmp_path root via _store_root=); HMIC source scope remained fixed at 36 (_FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES unmodified); no HATP readiness/activation state was changed; runtime remained unchanged throughout. pcae health healthy, pcae check passed, pcae status coherence coherent, pcae doctor task-memory warnings (pre-existing, unrelated), pcae push check clean, pcae notify status Telegram configured. FINAL VERDICT: B -- VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- ORIGINAL DEFECT CLOSED -- HMIC SCOPE EVOLUTION MAY PROCEED. HARDWARE-ENROLLMENT RECOVERY AUTHORITY DEFECT status: INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED AT TRUST-ENROLLMENT STANDALONE ADMIN ENTRY-POINT BOUNDARY (does not claim broader HATP readiness closure; does not claim Dell certification validates or is invalidated by these Mac-side-only repaired scripts).

test_results.provider_derived_identity_proof: _evidence_from_enrolled_credential's only parameters are (enrolled, enrollment_reference); all four identity fields trace directly to the provider's own EnrolledFido2Credential attributes with no caller override, confirmed via a sentinel-valued fake provider object.
test_results.one_hardware_ceremony_proof: With a flaky register_credential requiring 3 calls to succeed, _run_enrollment_ceremony call count remained exactly 1 across the whole enroll invocation.
test_results.retry_evidence_identity: All register_credential calls across a 3-attempt flaky sequence received the identical Python object (is-compared), never a regenerated or mutated evidence value.
test_results.retry_reachability_provenance: _register_with_in_process_retry is called from exactly one site (_cmd_enroll), textually after the ceremony call; no other module function calls it; no argparse dest maps onto a CredentialEnrollmentEvidence field beyond enrollment_reference.
test_results.exception_catch_scope: _HANDLED_ERRORS = (HATPHardwareCredentialAdminError, HATPHardwareCredentialStoreError, HATPHardwareProviderError, OSError), tuple-equality-asserted against the live module; bare Exception/KeyError/ValueError/AttributeError/RuntimeError/TypeError independently confirmed NOT subclasses via issubclass checks.
test_results.deterministic_conflict_retry_result: Retried the full 3-attempt budget then fails closed (re-raises CredentialConflictError); classified NON-BLOCKING -- redundant but no overwrite/reactivation/false-success, since the conflict path never writes.
test_results.malformed_state_retry_result: Retried 3 times against a permanently malformed store, never heals, fails closed; classified NON-BLOCKING.
test_results.permission_path_retry_result: Retried 3 times against a permanent PermissionError; no chmod/chown/fallback/alternate-path logic in the helper's source; fails closed; classified NON-BLOCKING.
test_results.unexpected_exception_result: AttributeError/TypeError NOT caught; propagates immediately on the first attempt (call count = 1); classified CLEAN, appropriately narrow catch scope.
test_results.never_landed_result: First attempt raises CredentialReadbackMismatchError, second attempt lands; one final authoritative record, correct CLI result.
test_results.already_landed_result: Real, unmocked core register_credential called twice with identical evidence against a disposable store: second call resolves ALREADY_REGISTERED via _candidate_equal; exactly one record persisted, no duplicate.
test_results.retry_exhaustion_result: Finite exactly-3 attempts (< 10, no infinite loop); no device re-touch; last error re-raised, never swallowed into a false success.
test_results.failure_diagnostic: 'REGISTRY PERSISTENCE DIAGNOSTIC: ... this operation requires governed reconciliation/retry; no manual credential import path exists.' Prints signer_key_id (public, non-secret identifier) only, never public_key_hex/algorithm/provider_profile; contains no 'paste these values' instruction.
test_results.no_recovery_evidence_output: Captured stderr on exhaustion contains zero occurrence of 'RECOVERY EVIDENCE' (case-insensitive) and zero occurrence of --public-key-hex/--signer-key-id flag text.
test_results.confirmation_zero_touch: enroll declined: writer call count = 0 (ceremony itself still runs, per documented design, since a completed physical ceremony cannot be undone by declining). revoke declined: writer call count = 0.
test_results.revoke_result: Valid revoke (active->revoked); idempotent monotonic replay (revoked_at unchanged); missing-ID fails closed (CredentialNotFoundError); no deletion, no other record mutated (confirmed with two registered credentials, revoking one leaves the other active).

test_results.path_containment: No --trust-store/--output-path/--store-root/--registry-path override flag exists anywhere in the script; the retry helper performs no filesystem I/O of its own.
